 Austin, TX — The holidays are a time for gathering, giving thanks, and sharing meals with the people we love. But for thousands of Central Texas families, putting food on the table remains a challenge. This season, the Central Texas Food Bank is calling on our community to help make sure our neighbors have the nourishment they need, and a special matching opportunity means your generosity could go even further! 
 We Are Austin host Trevor Scott welcomed back Mark Jackson, Chief Development Officer of the Central Texas Food Bank, to discuss the organization's holiday campaign, the growing need for food assistance, and how Central Texans can make a meaningful difference.
 We Are Austin welcomed Mark Jackson, Chief Development Officer of the Central Texas Food Bank, to share more about the organization's holiday campaign, the need for food assistance across our region, and how Austinites can come together to make a meaningful difference. 
 Watch the full segment above to learn how the Central Texas Food Bank is helping our neighbors and how you can get involved this holiday season!
 Fighting hunger across Central Texas
 The Central Texas Food Bank is the region's largest hunger relief organization, serving 21 counties through a network of more than 250 partner organizations and over 60 food distributions each month. 
 Jackson shared that approximately 600,000 people in the organization's service area experience food insecurity, and one in four children is at risk of hunger year-round.
 As the holidays approach, the need becomes especially meaningful for families hoping to share a traditional holiday meal.
 "This year we're going to be distributing over 22,000 turkeys," Jackson shared.
 That effort helps families create special holiday memories while receiving the nutritional support they need.
 Your holiday donation can make THREE times the difference!
 The food bank relies on community generosity to meet an extraordinary demand.
 "We're spending $1.3 million a month buying food," Jackson explained.
 That includes purchasing 11 truckloads of fresh produce every week to help supplement donated food.
 And right now, there's an incredible opportunity to make donations go further!
 The Central Texas Food Bank has a triple-match donation campaign underway, meaning a contribution that would normally help provide three meals can help provide nine meals through the matching opportunity, according to Jackson.
 Just $1 can help provide nine meals during this special campaign! 
 Give back now and throughout the year!
 Financial contributions are the food bank's greatest current need, but volunteers also play an essential role in keeping its operations running.
 While the holiday season often inspires an outpouring of volunteer support, Jackson encourages the community to continue giving its time after the celebrations end.
 "Keep that spirit alive into the New Year," he urged.
 January and February are especially important months for volunteers as the organization continues distributing food throughout the region.
 Need food assistance? Help is available!
 For families experiencing food insecurity, the Central Texas Food Bank makes it easy to find nearby resources.
 Simply visit CentralTexasFoodBank.org and enter your ZIP code or address to locate food distributions, hours of operation, and available assistance.
 The same website offers opportunities to donate, volunteer, and support the organization's holiday campaign.
 Whether you're giving your time, making a donation, or helping spread the word, every effort matters.
 Visit CentralTexasFoodBank.org to give help, find help, and make this holiday season a little brighter for our neighbors!
